mandala-7.title: Rigveda Mandala 7 – Hymns of Sage Vasistha
mandala-7.description: Rigveda Mandala 7 contains 104 hymns attributed to the Vedic sage Vasistha praising deities such as Varuna, Indra and Agni while emphasizing cosmic order (Rta) and divine protection.

hymns.introduction: This hymn belongs to Mandala 1 of the Rigveda. Rigvedic hymns are ancient Vedic verses revealed to sages (Rishis) and dedicated to cosmic principles and deities such as Agni, Indra, Varuna, Surya, Soma and others.
